verdict.rationale: Mistral's own docs index (llms.txt) includes an MCP page describing MCP as a protocol for integrating AI models with data sources and tools. Read alongside its Agents tool system, this suggests first-party MCP support, but the evidence only defines MCP and never explicitly describes connecting MCP servers. Function calling (docs-4/34) is a separate, adjacent capability and is not credited here. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to register or connect MCP servers to agents or the API, supported transports/auth, a description of how MCP tools are exposed to the model, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: MCP is an open standard protocol for seamless AI model integration with data sources and tools
